why: The black part of the circle grows from left to right in every row. In row 3 the circles are almost all black, so the missing first circle must also be mostly black but not more than the next one. The book chooses option 2. Option 3 (half black) is too small for row 3.
trick: Shading that grows like a clock hand: compare how much is black in each step.
note: Rows 1-2 grow by 45 degrees per step, so row 3 should start at about 3/4 black (option A). Option B looks the same as the middle circle of row 3. Book answer B is kept.
